title: Council Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2616 of 23 November 2026 implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities with a view to combating terrorism

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union
EN L series

sections.heading: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities with a view to combating terrorism

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union,
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to Council Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 of 27 December 2001 on specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities with a view to combating terrorism ( 1 ) , and in particular Article 7(1) thereof,
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 3

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy,
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 4

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 5
implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 6

paras.text: On 26 February 2026, the Council adopted Regulation (EU) 2026/456 ( 2 ) , which amended Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities with a view to combating terrorism.
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 7
implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 8

paras.text: In view of the continued threat posed by The Base, one person should be added to the list in Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001.
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 9
implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 10

paras.text: Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 11

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:
paras.loc: implementing Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 on specific restrictive measures direc, para 12

paras.text: Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 is amended in accordance with the Annex to this Regulation.
This Regulation shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
Done at Brussels, 23 November 2026.
For the Council
The President
M. HEYDON
